mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.2% compresses equity discount rates through accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as the policy stance remains easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of UNRATE < 4.0% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicates robust aggregate demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS rising, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 105.5 signals strong manufacturing output expansion, supporting economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO > 105.5 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP level above 17000 billion dollars indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of GDPC1 > 17000 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 245 signals persistent inflation that may trigger Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 245 instances, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) signals strong labor market with accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of UNRATE < 4.0% AND FEDFUNDS < 1.5% periods, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150,000 new jobs) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days during expansionary labor regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS > 150,000 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
